frequency_question: What is the historical frequency of a federal department revoking the recognition of a primary accrediting agency?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a federal department (e.g., Department of Education) has the authority to recognize or de-recognize an accrediting body for professional schools or programs.
provenance_note: claims 500 cases from only 3 named (166.7x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named; believed to be the total set of major revocations in the last decade.
known_gaps: Minor administrative sanctions that did not result in full revocation.
skeleton: Total number of recognized accrediting agencies (approx 50) monitored over a 10-year period, tracking revocation events.
validity_reason: Regulatory frameworks for accreditation recognition remain stable over 5-10 year cycles.
